title: 9 BOTTLES OF AUSTRALIAN WINE, ...
description: 9 BOTTLES OF AUSTRALIAN WINE, INCLUDING TASMANIAN - AS IS
findings: Title says Australian wine including Tasmanian, but the photos show a mixed lot where most bottles are from New Zealand, France and Germany. Nine bottles, labels read at full size and in crops: (1) 'Dr Van Diemen's Quite Amazing Tasmanian Devil Red Elixir', a purple-print novelty label with the Lions Club emblem and a comic cure-all list, dated 1975 and ending 'Convention ... November 1975' (partly legible), on a green bottle with a dark capsule; (2) Babich Black Label Sauvignon Blanc 2010, Marlborough, NZ; (3) Cloudy Bay Sauvignon Blanc (Marlborough, vintage not legible, screwcap); (4) Monowai Pinot Noir, Crownthorpe, Hawke's Bay, NZ (vintage reads 2016, last digit unclear); (5) Shaw + Smith M3 Chardonnay, Adelaide Hills, 2013; (6) Mildara 'Southern Cross' Late Harvest Muscat Blanc (older-style label, blue capsule, no vintage visible); (7) Dogrock (red dog logo) with a heavily foxed label that looks like Shiraz, vintage not legible; (8) a German 1977 Silvaner Qualitaetswein mit Praedikat Spaetlese, 'Herxheimer am Berg' (rest of the vineyard name torn off), 10.5% vol, eagle-crest label, gold foil capsule, wine deep amber; (9) Chablis, Terroir de Chichee, Vendanges 2012, Patrick Piuze, Chablis AC, product of France, cream closure, clean label. So only about four bottles (Shaw + Smith, Mildara, Dogrock and the Tasmanian novelty) are Australian. The Piuze Chablis, Shaw + Smith M3 and Cloudy Bay are the better-known names.
condition: Fill levels look normal in all nine (necks filled to or near the shoulder, none visibly low), though dark and coloured glass makes this hard to confirm. Capsules intact. Dr Van Diemen's label is stained and worn with brown spotting; Dogrock label is foxed and stained; the German label is torn at the left edge; the German wine and Shaw + Smith look deep gold to amber, so may be tired or oxidised. Others clean and dusty. Sold as is, storage history unknown.
reason: Title says Australian wine but the nine bottles are mostly NZ, French and German, including a Patrick Piuze Chablis 2012, Shaw + Smith M3 2013, Cloudy Bay, a 1977 German Spaetlese and a 1975 Lions Club Tasmanian novelty; roughly $120 to $220 retail if sound.
marks_read: Labels only: Dr Van Diemen's (Lions emblem, 1975); Babich Black Label SB 2010; Cloudy Bay; Monowai PN; Shaw + Smith M3 Chardonnay 2013; Mildara Southern Cross Late Harvest Muscat Blanc; Dogrock; Herxheimer am Berg Silvaner Spaetlese 1977; Patrick Piuze Chablis Terroir de Chichee 2012.

interest.note: 9 bottles, labels read: Dr Van Diemen's Tasmanian Devil Red Elixir (1975 Lions Club novelty), Babich Black Label Sauvignon Blanc 2010 (NZ), Cloudy Bay Sauvignon Blanc (NZ, vintage not legible), Monowai Pinot Noir (NZ, 2016?), Shaw + Smith M3 Chardonnay 2013 (Adelaide Hills), Mildara Southern Cross Late Harvest Muscat Blanc, Dogrock (red, likely Shiraz, label foxed), Herxheimer am Berg Silvaner Spaetlese 1977 (Germany, amber), Patrick Piuze Chablis Terroir de Chichee 2012. title: 1970'S JUNGHANS WALL CLOCK WIT...
description: 1970'S JUNGHANS WALL CLOCK WITH PENDULUM & WEIGHTS
findings: One photo. A chain-driven weight wall clock in a dark stained wood case with a broken-arch pediment and brass finial, a gold-toned dial with black Roman numerals, fleur-de-lys marks between the numerals, small '60' and '30' minute markings, cast gilt corner mounts and ornate gilt hands. No maker's name, logo or signature is visible on the dial, case, weights or pendulum, and the movement and back are not shown, so the Junghans attribution in the title is neither supported nor contradicted by the photos. The paper stickers are the lot number and one blank tag. Style fits a 1970s German-style Vienna regulator reproduction.
condition: Case and dial look clean with no obvious damage; brass weights bright. Working order unknown, not tested, movement not shown.
reason: Junghans claim not shown anywhere on the clock; common 1970s style weight-driven wall clock, modest value.
marks_read: None legible (no maker name on dial; stickers are lot number and a blank tag).

interest.note: Chain-driven weight wall clock, a clock not a watch or watch movement. Title says 1970s Junghans but no maker name is visible on the dial or case and the movement is not photographed. Gold dial, Roman numerals, broken-arch case, two brass weights and pendulum present.
